preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_1) and all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_2) and all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in virus)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_1, s_2, and virus are uppercase English letters.
Lengths of s_1, s_2, and virus are between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) == 0 or (all(c in s_1 for c in stdout.strip()) and all(c in s_2 for c in stdout.strip()))
postconditions.description: If output is non-empty, it is a common subsequence of s_1 and s_2.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) == 0 or virus not in stdout.strip()
postconditions.description: If output is non-empty, it does not contain virus as a substring.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip()) == 0 or (not any(len(lcs) > len(stdout.strip()) for lcs in [get_lcs(s_1, s_2) if virus not in get_lcs(s_1, s_2) else '']))
postconditions.description: If output is non-empty, it is the longest possible common subsequence of s_1 and s_2 that does not contain virus as a substring.
Output is either empty (0) or a non-empty string.
